name: f5_pseudo2025
_doc: configs/f5_final.json on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members; the meta member's month-out predictions are its kernel's mo_G1.csv (per held month, fitted on the other three). L1a-v2 loadings refitted without the held month on the stacking lane's pass-1 rows (meta_gbm-G1short-f4p1_{mode}.parquet, col post2_recovered). Equivalent to research/final/meta/configs/meta_gbm-G1short-f4_pseudo2025.json.

prc-f-x5._note: x5 pinned to xgboost 2.1.4: prc-f-x5-mo/output/oof.csv holds all four folds (M1/M6 from that run, M2/M7 copied from prc-f-x5p-mo; identical values checked). The xgboost 3.4.1 runs were renamed prc-f-x5-xgb341 / prc-f-x5-mo-xgb341 and are not used.
